The DMMCheck Plus Multi-Function Calibration Reference is a precision voltage and current reference designed to calibrate a wide variety of test and measurement instruments. It is a versatile and easy-to-use calibration reference that ensures that  test equipment is accurate and in compliance with industry standards.
